## Newer Geometries

- Spherical: S2 Geometry
  - Used by Tinder
  - [S2 Geometry Reference](http://s2geometry.io/)
  - [S2 R Package](https://r-spatial.github.io/s2/)
- Hexagonal: H3 Indexing
  - Used by Uber
  - [H3 Indexing Reference](https://h3geo.org/)
  - [H3 R Package](https://crazycapivara.github.io/h3-r/index.html)
- Hexagonal: Alfa Mutual
  - 2,600 hexagons coverage Alabama
  - Date Filed: 2025-05-14
  - Date Effective: 2025-08-24

::: {.notes}
s2 was used by Tinder
h3 is used by Uber

Has an ever increasing number of territories as you zoom in
Good for finding things near each other, like for catastrophes

Alfa Mutual is the only reference to hexagonal geometries I could find. The IDs differ from h3 though, so they might have constructed their own hexagons
SERFF: ALFA-134414286
Date Filed: 2025-05-14
Date Effective: 2025-08-24
:::
